about: Alert rules for this build. Thresholds were chosen for teaching; a real service derives them from its own targets.

rules.name: HighErrorRate
rules.why: More than 5% of requests ended in a 503 or a timeout for two windows in a row.

rules.name: SlowAnswers
rules.why: The estimated 95th-percentile latency of answered requests reached 2 seconds.

rules.name: QueueBacklog
rules.why: An arriving request found 15 or more requests ahead of it.

rules.name: TokenSpend
rules.why: The model generated 3,000 or more output tokens in one window.
